rationale.complete: Round 1 done for both arms with synthetic validation, per-period verdicts, an NE34 event study, post hoc diagnostics and a frozen confirmatory script; holdout, embedding swap and a validated monitor are still missing.
rationale.faithfulness: The 'few modes' half holds descriptively (one uniform mode beats MP, T_eff and cross-day nulls, C = 1, D = 1) but is half lulls, and the defining groupthink claim, PR collapse at kickoffs and consensus, failed in the wrong direction.
rationale.usefulness: Yields a fit-free monitor (self-repetition and cross-agent echo rates, mode strength vs its own baseline) that flagged the looping weeks, but it is post hoc and the groupthink alarm has no positive case to validate against.

one_line: One market mode, no kickoff collapse; low-dimensional weeks are agents looping on their own text.
